base: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game terrain sprite sheet with TWO DISTINCT COMPLETE CONNECTED SIDE-VIEW LANDSCAPES stacked vertically, TOP is first named landscape and BOTTOM second. Each landscape spans nearly full width and occupies less than half the sheet, separated by a generous TRANSPARENT gutter. Genuine transparent alpha background, no sky/backdrop. Premium tactile hand-painted cartoon material textures, dimensional rounded edges, readable silhouettes. A FEW ENORMOUS recognisable objects form the actual contiguous walkable landform with ramps, natural tunnels and supporting connections. Every object physically connects, no floating props, no repeated horizontal slices, no rows of disconnected shelves. Broad terrain masses, useful lower and upper routes, one small repair gap per landscape. Keep safe broad end ledges. No lettering, labels, UI, characters, entrances or exits. Strict 2D side view, no isometric perspective. Not an infographic. Full square sheet at highest detail.
